text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the consideration. I think I 
will take you up on that rest.
Hayahide... Hey, Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Hm? What's this, a young girl's voice...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text: It's meee! Your favorite pair of glasses~.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
These glasses come with a conversation 
feature?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
S-So... what is it? Did you have something 
you wanted to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
You're always showin' me such pretty 
sights, so I just wanted to say thanks~♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful view...? I'm sorry, nothing 
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Show me, will ya! The smiling crowd... 
fired up over a real, serious showdown...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
A fierce struggle with her rival, ...the 
finish line draws near—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"Thank ya so much for always lettin' me 
watch from these special seats! Ehehe!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Glasses... No, comrade. It is I who should 
be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both when I was in despair and the scenery 
grew distant and hazy... and when I 
rejoiced over a fleeting advantage, losing 
sight of my goal.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to see the path 
to victory clearly, without a single 
doubt...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Looking forward to working with 
you from now on. ...Just saying.

Thanks to that heartwarming dream, Biwa 
Hayahide seemed to have refreshed her 
mood.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide's Glasses
text_block_list.text:
If you cheat on your glasses with contact 
lenses, I'll never forgive youuu!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh... What was that just now...?

Troubled by bad dreams, a lingering gloom 
remained...
